payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the data collection process, including the use of a crowdsourcing platform and the collection of conversational dialogs.

claims.text: The dataset was collected using the crowdsourcing platform CrowdFlower (CF).
Data was collected from conversational dialogs with workers on CrowdFlower for evaluation purposes.
The data collection process involved manually collecting templates and keywords from frequent expressions used by CF workers.
The collected dataset enables simulation of interactive learning and evaluation of dialog systems.
